Name: Custom Locks Updated
Author: rokugin
Description:
[size=5]Original mod updated!
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6251]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6251[/url]


[/size][u][size=5]
Install[/size][/u]
[size=3]1. [url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url]﻿.
2. Unzip the mod folder into the Stardew Valley/Mods folder.
3. Run the game using SMAPI.
﻿(optionally) Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] by spacechase0.﻿[/size]

[u][size=5]About[/size][/u]
[size=3]Based on[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6251] Custom Locks[/url]﻿ by aedenthorn. Rebuilt for Stardew Valley 1.6.
Lets you enter buildings and rooms when you would normally be restricted by time/date, relationship status, or events.

Toggle being able to enter the general store on Wednesday, entering buildings outside of normal hours, entering homes and rooms when at less than 2 hearts with a required NPC, early entry to the Adventurer's Guild, and entry during events.

Newly added is the movie theater, originally there was no code to handle it but now it should function mostly like the rest of the buildings but using its own caveats. You can't enter on festival days because the base logic for inviting NPC's to the theater is that you can't on festival days, so just to avoid any issues there you can't enter.
[/size]
[u][size=5]Compatibility[/size][/u]
[size=3]Works with the 1.6 PC version of Stardew Valley.
I don't have the game on anything else, so I can't currently say if it works anywhere else.
Works in multiplayer, everyone who wants to benefit from the mod has to have it installed.

Downtown Zuzu - version 2.4.0 of Custom Locks Updated adds a compatibility patch, so this should be working for DTZ properly now!

Stardew Valley Expanded - I tested it a little bit, I don't play SVE so I can't be sure it'll work everywhere but it works much better than my first attempt at this mod.

[/size][url=https://github.com/rokugin/CustomLocksUpdated][size=3]Source[/size][/url]
